scope: One standalone dry-land Industrial Harbour encounter using the real AdvancedShooterSystem fire/reload/damage path.

ownership.module: CoastalExpansion58 is disabled by default and must only be enabled in the UE5.8 host.
ownership.input: One runtime Enhanced Input component at priority 5; existing menu, recovery and interaction owners retain higher priorities.
ownership.inventory: Weapon clip and reserve are transient encounter state. No AGIS items, pickup path, save record or inventory shadow is created.
ownership.lifecycle: Encounter exit, campaign epoch change, defeat/recovery, player replacement and EndPlay unequip and destroy the transient weapon.
ownership.ui: One project-owned noninteractive overlay consumes only authoritative component state. Vendor demo widgets are not instantiated.

live_cases: A clear shot applies point damage and consumes exactly one authoritative round.
A saved Visibility collision wall blocks target damage.
Pause rejects fire without ammo mutation.
Reload publishes only actual clip/reserve values after completion.
An in-range sentry does not attack off-screen, then attacks when visibly rendered through clear line of sight.
Lethal damage enters the existing recovery flow and resets transient health/shield.
Campaign reload destroys the prior epoch weapon object.
sentry_policy: A sentry attacks only inside its bounded home radius, inside range, with Visibility line of sight, while recently rendered and while the player combat gate accepts hostile damage.
presentation: The authored weapon and each accepted shot use real StaticMesh components. Tracers have collision disabled and a bounded 0.08 second lifespan.
not_claimed: No editor authoring or PIE case has run.
No physical-device aiming, Windows package, multiplayer or collectible-ammo support is claimed.
No close-range martial attack is included because the staged shooter payload supplies no compatible melee animation or API.
open_review_findings: Project tracer uses an unspread ray while vendor damage uses spread; authoritative callback integration was interrupted by user pause.
Wrapper shot cooldown uses game time while vendor rate limiting uses real time; time-dilation mismatch remains.
Updated controller input probe and live harness are compiled/prepared but live controls acceptance has not run.
